# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 6 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** Trust in the LORD

---

**6:1** Blessed is the man whose heart is prepared to call upon the name of the LORD;
he will be saved when he remembers the name of the LORD.

**6:2** His ways are established by the LORD,
and the works of his hands are kept by God.

**6:3** His soul will not be terrified by a troubling dream;
when he passes through rivers and the surge of waters, he will not be disturbed.

**6:4** He wakes from sleep and blesses the name of the LORD;
when his heart is peaceful he sings praise to the name of his God.

**6:5** He asks mercy from the LORD for all his house;
and the LORD hears the prayer of all who fear him.

**6:6** May the LORD fulfill all the requests of those who fear him;
blessed are the devout of the LORD with his salvation.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal English rendering following Greek syntax. Poetic lineation preserved.*
